# Monogram Maker

Monogram maker: design a monogram from your initials for weddings, stationery, embroidery, signet rings and personal brands, in classic, modern or floral styles.

## What it does
Give the initials, the style and the colors. Claude tells you the price and designs the monogram.

**How the files are made:** each monogram is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The letters are drawn by the model, so check them in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install monogram-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Monogram Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/monogram/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each monogram uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The monograms show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_monogram_models` | Models for monograms with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_monogram_cost` | Exact price of one monogram before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_monogram` | Starts one monogram in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_monogram` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Design a wedding monogram for E&L in gold script"
- "Make a modern minimal monogram with the letters JM"
- "Create a floral wreath monogram with the letter A"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the monogram (the initials, style and colors) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
